title: Kneeling Before the Eldritch Eye
description: A woman with short black hair in a pink gothic dress and gloves kneels on stone ground, looking up at a massive red tentacled monster with a single large eye and fanged mouth emerging from a swirling vortex. A pink and purple striped gothic cathedral stands behind her as orange glowing cards with symbols float through the air.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene of a woman with short black hair wearing a shiny pink gothic dress, pink gloves and a black choker, kneeling on cracked stone and looking up in awe at a giant red fleshy tentacled monster with one huge orange eye and sharp teeth, emerging from a swirling dark vortex. Behind her stands a tall pink and purple striped gothic cathedral with intricate windows. Orange glowing rectangular cards with various symbols float all around the scene, dark teal sky, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
